title: 2AM Laundromat Slow Dance
summary: Two unnamed strangers fold a sheet, then slow-dance between dryers. The attendant mops around them. EyeWash always on in the corner.
visualArc: Fluorescent rows → shared sheet → dance in dryer glow → attendant mop → sign-off TV.

segments.label: Off-balance dryer
segments.onScreen: Two strangers several machines apart. Rain on the glass. Attendant mopping.
segments.lyrics:
STRANGER 1: You don't have to.
STRANGER 2: I know. That's why I'm doing it.
segments.musicCue: Diegetic EyeWash TV, then The Laundromat Saints full score.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Interior of a 24-hour laundromat at 2 AM, harsh fluorescent overhead light mixed with the warm amber glow of a single running dryer, rain streaking the front windows, two strangers standing several machines apart watching one off-balance dryer, an attendant in a hi-vis vest mopping in the background, lonely and warm, filmic, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 10-second locked laundromat interior. One dryer off-balance. Rain. Photoreal.
